fields.help_zh: envd 注入动作配置。将 envd 守护进程打包进沙箱镜像，仅第一代沙箱支持

parameters.help_en: The template build configuration. The configuration is divided into action blocks, each with its own enabled switch. If an action block is not specified, it is equivalent to setting enabled to false. When an action block is specified, the enabled field is required. The execution order is: pull the source image, inject envd, and push to the destination repository
parameters.help_zh: 模板的构建配置，按动作分块指定构建流程。整段不传时，由服务根据源镜像自动推导：公共运行时镜像直接使用不构建，其余镜像自动执行 copy 与 envdInject
